content.user_title: Build Course Outlines and Lesson Materials
content.value_statement: Course preparation can be slow when ideas are scattered. This skill turns discussion into a clear outline and lesson materials.
actual_capabilities: Guides a discussion to clarify the audience, topic, goal, and required documents.
Creates a course outline with a main thread, modules, timing, materials, and preparation tasks.
Supports quick co-creation or stricter step-by-step confirmation before drafting.
Expands an approved outline into lesson content with concepts, cases, demonstrations, and summaries.
Separates core documents from optional guides, registration steps, and reference materials.
limitations: It relies on user input for subject accuracy and course context.
It does not verify facts, citations, or tool instructions automatically.
It focuses on outlines and lesson documents, not full curriculum strategy.
It does not generate final slide design assets or visual branding.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Training Session
use_cases.description: Turn an instructor's rough idea into a timed outline and learner-facing lesson document.

use_cases.title: Refine an Existing Lesson
use_cases.description: Review a partial outline, improve the module order, and fill gaps before class.

use_cases.title: Create Workshop Materials
use_cases.description: Build a practical workshop flow with examples, demonstrations, and optional preparation guides.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Lesson
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a topic and a rough goal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare a lesson about [topic] for [audience]. Use quick co-creation and draft the first outline.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Draft Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Use an existing outline as the starting point.
prompt_templates.prompt: Here is my current outline. Please identify gaps, ask key questions, and propose a clearer module structure.

prompt_templates.title: Build Full Lesson Materials
prompt_templates.scenario: Expand an approved outline into teachable content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this confirmed outline to write lesson materials with opening context, module content, examples, demonstrations, summary, and homework.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Structured Workshop
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan a session that needs pacing, activities, and supporting documents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workshop plan for [duration] with strict confirmation. Include timing, activities, materials, learner preparation, and optional support documents.

output_examples.input: I need a 60-minute introduction to AI tools for operations managers.
output_examples.output: A course outline with a one-sentence learning goal, four modules, timing, tool requirements, and preparation tasks.

output_examples.input: I have an outline, but the order feels confusing.
output_examples.output: A revised module sequence, missing questions, and a confirmed structure before detailed writing begins.

output_examples.input: Please turn the approved outline into lesson content.
output_examples.output: A lesson document with opening remarks, key concepts, examples, demonstration steps, summaries, and homework.

best_practices: Share the target audience, course duration, and desired outcome before drafting.
Confirm the full course framework before asking for detailed lesson content.
List required tools, accounts, examples, and learner preparation early.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full document before the course framework is confirmed.
Do not mix instructor notes, learner materials, and optional guides without labels.
Do not rely on the skill to validate facts or external tool procedures.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates course outlines and lesson materials through a guided discussion.

faq.question: Can it work from a rough idea?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks clarifying questions and turns early ideas into a structured draft.

faq.question: Can I use it with an existing outline?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review an existing outline, suggest improvements, and expand approved sections.

faq.question: Does it create slide files?
faq.answer: No. It writes lesson content and document structure, but it does not create final slide design files.

faq.question: Does it support different collaboration speeds?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports quick co-creation and stricter step-by-step confirmation.

faq.question: Should I verify the final lesson content?
faq.answer: Yes. You should review facts, examples, timing, and tool instructions before teaching.
